summary: Admin Console REAL-DATA verification (iter924). Backend: 23/23 pytest tests pass — /api/admin/overview, /api/admin/subscriptions/analytics, /api/admin/ai/monitor, /api/admin/billing/overview and observability heartbeats all return DB-derived JSON whose values match direct MongoDB ground truth queries exactly (users total=857, premium=2, basic=1, free=854, revenue=$8082.38 across 210 payments; sso_callback_liveness_daily heartbeat present). Non-admin free user (p1.free.*) blocked with 401/403 on all admin endpoints; anonymous also blocked. Frontend: admin login flow works end-to-end, /admin-console loads Operations Console with real numbers (Duplication Drift 57.06% 1239/17/2201, Global Parity PASS 22/2 fail, Live Alerts 12), /admin/llm-billing shows real cost telemetry ($0.0017 today / $1.9662 MTD / 21,980 calls / real model+feature cost breakdown), /admin/email-delivery-ledger shows real recipients (admin@realaicoach.app, p1.free.1779113329@example.com) with real idempotency + timestamps, /admin/observability-center shows real samples (3854 LCP/CLS samples, 3172 security events, 16 SIEM open, real correlation coverage). NO placeholder / lorem / TODO / mock strings found on the loaded panels. HOWEVER — /admin/subscription-dashboard is BROKEN with a JS runtime error 'ReferenceError: s is not defined' (crashes to error-boundary), so its real-data content cannot be verified in the UI even though the backing API /api/admin/subscriptions/analytics returns correct DB-matched data.

ui_bugs.issue: Screen crashes to error-boundary with 'ReferenceError: s is not defined' on load. Bundled JS trace: index-d687888ab612f63525bb4d9898eb6757.js:1979:12152 -> Y -> Ha. UI shows generic 'Something went wrong / ERROR DETAILS: s is not defined / Reload Page / Try Again'. Since the backing endpoints (/api/admin/subscriptions/analytics, /api/admin/payment-analytics/subscriptions/*) all return 200 with correct DB-matched data, this is purely a frontend rendering bug — likely a variable referenced in a hook or callback before declaration, or a minifier-hoisting issue in the 921-line file.
ui_bugs.selector: route:/admin/subscription-dashboard (error boundary text 'ERROR DETAILS s is not defined')

action_items: FIX /admin/subscription-dashboard runtime error 'ReferenceError: s is not defined'. Grep /app/frontend/app/admin/subscription-dashboard.tsx for out-of-scope identifiers (likely a state setter or a helper used inside a closure before its declaration, or a stale name after a rename). Repro: log in as admin -> navigate to /admin/subscription-dashboard -> error boundary is rendered instead of the dashboard. Once fixed, the API side is already correct (verified in TestSubscriptionAnalyticsMatchesDB).

OPTIONAL: /api/auth/me is called once BEFORE the session cookie is set at startup (401), then re-called after login (200). This is intentional bootstrap probing, but if you want to silence the noisy 'Failed to load resource: 401' console error, gate the first /api/auth/me until cookie hydration completes.

/api/admin/ai/monitor counts search_logs / playback_events / conversations from three collections; currently all 0 in this env (which is an honest empty state, not fabrication).

SubscriptionDashboard screen at /app/frontend/app/admin/subscription-dashboard.tsx is 921 lines — recommend splitting into smaller focused sub-components (>700-line guideline). The 's is not defined' error is very likely a symptom of a monolithic file with tangled scope.
/admin/security is a thin deeplink to /admin-console?category=security — correct pattern, no rendering issues.
iter923 heartbeat (sso_callback_liveness_daily) is present in scheduler_heartbeats with status=healthy — surfaced correctly in observability-center's Correlation Coverage.
Free user account (p1.free.1779113329@example.com) properly returns 403 on all /api/admin/* endpoints; anonymous returns 401. RBAC verified.

rca of the issue: SubscriptionDashboard crash — ROOT CAUSE (probable, not confirmed by opening the file): a minified variable name collision or a reference-before-declaration inside the 921-line /app/frontend/app/admin/subscription-dashboard.tsx. MITIGATION for main agent: grep the file for `s` used as an identifier outside of a declared scope (setState 's', function param 's', etc.), or split the file into smaller components.
